audience: small businesses in Romania that bill customers with QuickInvoice

useCases.title: Review invoices and their totals
useCases.text: List invoices by status, type, customer, search text or date range, newest first. Open one invoice to see its lines, totals and customer.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and its invoices
useCases.text: Search customers by text and open one to read its details. List the invoices of that customer to check their status.

useCases.title: Check service prices before billing
useCases.text: List the products and services with their prices and VAT rates. Open one to read its net price before you bill it.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for a customer
useCases.text: Give the customer, the lines, the net unit prices and the tax rates. VAT is computed from the rate. A new invoice can use a number in its series, so confirm the details first.
